text_block_list.text:
"The JBC Classic. The decisive battle on 
home turf in Funabashi."

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fans
text_block_list.text: Falu-ko! Falu-ko!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Funabashi! Let's pump it up!!
(UOOOOOOH!)

...Cheers so loud you couldn't tell whose 
home turf it was. And confidence 
overflowing from every corner.

Smart Falcon is entering her prime. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: *inhale, exhale...* *inhale, exhale...*

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —Let us go, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The hopes entrusted to me by everyone in 
Funabashi— I will make sure they bear 
fruit.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Revived, right here at Funabashi 
Racecourse!
choice_data_list: Ah... She hasn't lost at all, has she...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I didn't lose? To Falcon-san, you mean?
That's also true. However—
choice_data_list: Even among the past Central champions...

text_block_list.text:
"Led by Crimson Nova, there were champions 
in the JRA who ran bearing immense 
responsibilities."

Right now, Furioso's fighting spirit is 
not one bit inferior to theirs.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The champions of the URA throughout 
history... —Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The number of burdens one carries may 
vary. However, the weight of those burdens 
is no different.

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fans
text_block_list.text: Falu-ko! Falu-ko!

text_block_list.name: Falco's Fans
text_block_list.text: Falu...
(UOOOOOOH!)

A roar of applause that swallowed up the 
cheers for the umadol. Local fervor that 
overwhelmed even nationwide popularity.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Race Fan
text_block_list.text: Furioso!! Furioso!!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text: Furi-chan, win this... You have to!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text: Furi-pyon...!

The junior Umamusume who had followed me 
all this time.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Got it?! Once they enter the track, 
everyone cheer with all your might!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Ohh!!

Every single student of Funabashi Tracen, 
who stuck with me through all that 
training.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, it's starting! Turn on the TV, the 
TV!"

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's finally time...! Like hell I'm 
gonna lose!

People all over town cheered for me and 
supported me in so many different ways.

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Race Fan
text_block_list.text: Furioso!! Furioso!!

The people roar. The town roars. All of 
Funabashi unites to push her toward 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Furioso-san...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let us compete fair and square, 
Falcon-san.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not the kind of person who can save a 
nation, nor do I have countless fans 
across the country. Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I stand here shouldering the things I hold 
most dear.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Even small circles hold power! I swear, 
spring will come to my beloved Funabashi!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I am not the Commander-in-Chief of 
Japan, but—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: The Supreme Commander of Funabashi!
(UOOOOOOH!)

Pride etched across a back carrying the 
hopes of her homeland. Our supreme 
commander now—takes the field.
